caption:
You can grow on Instagram without posting a single Reel. Mosseri confirmed it on October 23, 2026 — there are accounts growing on photos alone.

If video paralyses you, that sentence is worth more than any hook template. The number of people who have posted nothing for eight months because they can't face being on camera is enormous, and they were never actually required to be.

What Mosseri did say: carousels do better than single photos. The mechanics are simple — more slides means more interactions, and the auto-advance gives the post a second chance with someone who scrolled past the first frame.

So the honest version of format advice is not "Reels or die". It's that each format has a job: Reels reach people who don't follow you, carousels earn depth and saves from the ones who do.

Be careful with anyone quoting you an exact multiple here. The published numbers contradict each other wildly depending on whether the denominator is reach or followers. The direction is solid. The decimals are not.

Pick the format you'll actually keep making.
